title: AgentMicro — Live Codex task status in your macOS menu bar
excerpt: AgentMicro keeps the live state of your Codex tasks in the macOS menu bar.
content_html:
AgentMicro View on GitHub

A LOCAL-FIRST COMPANION FOR CODEX

Track parallel Codex tasks, projects, and results without reopening Codex.

Free and open source · macOS 14+ · Codex Desktop or CLI

01

Know what needs you

See thinking, unread results, input requests, errors, and idle tasks at a glance.

02

Return in one click

Open the matching Codex Desktop conversation directly from the task menu.

03

Keep work on your Mac

AgentMicro reads local session metadata. It never uploads prompts, code, responses, or task history.

A CLEARER QUEUE

Six status lights. Five honest states.

Working tasks stay first. Each row adds the project, current-turn duration, and a fast-mode marker, so you can decide where to return without searching through windows.

  • Thinking
  • Unread result
  • Needs input
  • Error
  • Idle

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your task queue is not another cloud service.

Base mode needs no Accessibility permission and no account. Optional enhanced detection is explicitly enabled, reads visible local labels only, and never clicks, types, or approves anything for you.

Spend less time checking on agents.

Get AgentMicro

Independent, community-maintained, and not affiliated with OpenAI or CodexBar.

本地首个 Codex 伴侣

无需重新打开 Codex 即可跟踪并行 Codex 任务、项目和结果。

免费开源 · macOS 14+ · Codex 桌面或 CLI

01

知道什么需要你

一目了然地查看思考、未读结果、输入请求、错误和空闲任务。

02

一键返回

直接从任务菜单打开匹配的 Codex Desktop 对话。

03

继续在 Mac 上工作

AgentMicro 读取本地会话元数据。 它从不上传提示、代码、响应或任务历史记录。

队列更清晰

六个状态灯。 五诚实国。

工作任务放在第一位。 每行都会添加项目、当前回合持续时间和快速模式标记，因此您可以决定返回哪里，而无需在窗口中搜索。

  • 思维
  • 未读结果
  • 需要输入
  • Error
  • Idle

私密设计

您的任务队列不是另一个云服务。

基本模式不需要辅助功能权限，也不需要帐户。 可选的增强检测已明确启用，仅读取可见的本地标签，并且从不为您单击、键入或批准任何内容。

花更少的时间检查代理。

Get AgentMicro

独立、由社区维护、不隶属于 OpenAI 或 CodexBar。
